name: Analog Communication Systems
summary: How information rides on carriers: AM, FM and PM, transmitters and superheterodyne receivers, multiplexing and the effect of noise.

topics.name: Elements of a communication system; channels, bandwidth and noise
Amplitude modulation: DSB-SC, conventional AM, SSB and VSB
AM modulators and demodulators (envelope and coherent detection)
Angle modulation: FM and PM, spectra and Carson's rule
FM generation and detection (discriminators, PLL demodulators)
Superheterodyne receivers: mixing, IF, image frequency
Noise in communication systems: thermal noise, SNR, noise figure
Noise performance of AM and FM; pre-emphasis and de-emphasis
Pulse modulation: PAM, PWM, PPM and an introduction to PCM
